settings.adjudication: Only rules-terminal games and explicit time/illegal-move forfeits are scored. Move-cap truncations remain unfinished and unscored.
settings.clockPolicy: Competition clock exhaustion is a forfeit regardless of remaining mating material; such wins are reported separately from checkmate.

caveats: This small pilot cannot establish a reliable Elo change.
Identical model weights are shared; this tests decision-engine changes, not a new trained network.
The configured node limits can count different work units across engine versions. They are recorded separately; total move budgets and game clocks are equal.
Wall-time limits are soft because individual synchronous operations cannot be interrupted. Actual elapsed time around the entire decision call is deducted from equal game clocks.
Opening order is fixed; colors reverse within each pair. No evaluation-based win/draw adjudication is used.
